value.text: plan of the Basilica of Sant'Ambrogio of Milan. (A) Atrium; (B) Walls, lapidary collection; (C) Tomb of Pier Candido Decembrio; (D) Statue of Pius IX by Francesco Confalonieri (1880); (E) Three superimposed early 13th-century frescoes; (F) Isolated column; (G) Pulpit; (H) Ciborium; (I) Abbatial throne; (L) Wooden choir; (M) First chapel; (N) Second chapel; (O) Third chapel; (P) Fourth chapel; (Q) Fifth chapel; (R) Sixth chapel; (S) Seventh chapel; (T) Antichapel of S. Satiro; (U) Chapel of S. Victor in Ciel d’Oro; (V) Altar; (W) Fresco Christ risen between two angels by Bergognone (c. 1491); (X) Madonna, tondo by Luini; (Y) Portico of the Canonica.
